Meanwhile, 울버햄프턴 원더러스 lost the first three games of their first top flight campaign for 20 years; 볼턴 원더러스 and 미들즈브러 completed the bottom three. The race to get into the Premier League was headed by 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 , who were a point ahead of their nearest rivals Reading and 셰필드 유나이티드 at the top of Division One. 위건 애슬레틱 , 크리스털 팰리스 and 웨스트햄 유나이티드 completed the top six.

Birmingham remained fourth, while 풀럼 moved into the top five at the expense of 사우샘프턴. 레스터 시티 and 미들즈브러 propped up the Premier League after an upturn in fortunes for 울버햄프턴 원더러스 and 토트넘 홋스퍼; Leeds had slipped into the relegation zone as the mass sale of players to help pay off mounting debts took its toll on the field. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 were in eighth place, just below 맨체스터 시티. 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 were top of Division One, where 위건 애슬레틱 were playing for the first time in their history. 노리치 시티, 셰필드 유나이티드, 선덜랜드 and 웨스트햄 유나이티드 completed the top six. 입스위치 타운 were a single goal short of the play-off places.

According to O'Shea, a sports celebrity demanding 'appearance money' from a charity is unheard of in his experience. Ferguson's appearance fee amounted to half the money raised. The fundraisers, until now unaware that Ferguson had taken half the proceeds, denounce his behaviour and say if they had known about it at the time they would have cancelled the event.

events.title: 맨체스터 유나이티드 topped the Premier League, with unbeaten 아스널 a point behind and a game in hand. 첼시's bid for the title took a setback; they were in third place with a seven-point gap between them and the top spot followed by Charlton and 리버풀. Leeds, 울버햄프턴 원더러스 and 레스터 시티 occupied the bottom three places. 노리치 시티 and 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 were still leading the way at the top of Division One. 셰필드 유나이티드, 선덜랜드, 입스위치 타운 and 위건 애슬레틱 occupied the play-off zone.

events.title: 미들즈브러 won their first ever trophy as a professional club by beating 볼턴 원더러스 in the League Cup final . In the Premier League, 아스널 were still unbeaten and were top of the league with a nine-point advantage over 첼시 and 맨체스터 유나이티드. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 and Charlton completed the top five, followed closely by 리버풀 and 애스턴 빌라. Leeds and 레스터 시티 remained in the bottom three, but 울버햄프턴 원더러스 had climbed out of the drop zone at the expense of 포츠머스. 노리치 시티 and 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 remained at the top of Division One, and 웨스트햄 유나이티드 edged 셰필드 유나이티드 out of an otherwise unchanged play-off zone.

events.title: 아스널, the first team to complete 30 matches unbeaten at the start of a league season, led 첼시 by seven points with 맨체스터 유나이티드 a further five points behind. They were also in contention for both the Champions League and the FA Cup. 리버풀 and 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 completed the top five as Charlton's bid for a European place was fading fast, the competition now coming from Birmingham and 애스턴 빌라 . At the other end of the table, time was running out for 울버햄프턴 원더러스 and Leeds; 레스터 시티 were still giving the rest of the bottom ten a good run for their money. 노리치 시티 and 웨스트브로미치 앨비언 were equal on points at the top of Division One, and 밀월 had edged 위건 애슬레틱 out of the top six.

events.title: 레스터 시티's relegation from the Premier League was confirmed just one season after promotion; 울버햄프턴 원더러스 needed to win both of their remaining games by a significant margin and hope that 맨체스터 시티 would suffer heavy defeats in both of theirs to survive, despite beating 에버턴. Leeds still needed at least a draw against Bolton to have any chance of avoiding relegation. At the top of the Premiership, 첼시 looked set for second place while 맨체스터 유나이티드 seemed certain to settle for third place, with 리버풀 and 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 completing the top five.
